items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: he'd say, man, you remember you taught me how to play this song? He'd say I still play the same way you taught it to me.

ctx.x: Yeah. Tell me that story about it.

Yeah, well he, whenever I see him, you know if he's around the piano he'll play what's new. And he'd tell me, he'd say, man, you remember you taught me how to play this song? He'd say I still play the same way you taught it to me. You know? What's new? Bob Crosby, remember him? Uh huh.
